item.title: Greek Cheese from Naxos Crowned Best in the World 2025
item.description: Naxos Graviera has been crowned the best cheese in the world for 2025–2026 by TasteAtlas, topping the global ranking thanks to thousands of verified real-user reviews. The iconic PDO hard cheese from the Cyclades island of Naxos beat every other cheese worldwide with its months-long aging and distinctive mild, rich flavor. item.title: Lasers Reveal Lost Cities on Tiny Greek Islands
item.description: Using airborne LIDAR and magnetometry for the first time in the Cyclades, archaeologists have discovered prehistoric settlements, medieval structures, and possible Palaeolithic traces on 87 uninhabited islands – proving the archipelago was colonised far earlier and more densely than ever imagined. item.title: Greece Targets Top-Tier Status in Global Wellness & Medical Tourism Boom
item.description: Greece ranks joint-5th worldwide as a wellness destination yet only 45th in revenue, leaving €12 billion+ on the table. A new EBRD-backed study projects the sector could reach €15 billion with just €13 million in strategic investment – leveraging 750+ thermal springs, Blue Zone longevity, and competitive medical services.
